title: Acetylbinankadsurin A Decreases Macrophage Glycolysis and Pro-Inflammatory Phenotype Polarization via Inhibiting HIF-1alpha to Alleviate Hepatic Fibrosis in Mice.
authors: Yao, Qiang; Peng, Wangxia; Lu, Huaguan; Yang, Yupei; Rao, Ziti; Xie, Xin; Huang, Dan; Wang, Wei; Yan, Jianye; Liu, Jianjun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物ACBA通过抑制HIF-1alpha缓解肝纤维化，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Hepatic fibrosis is a prevalent pathological process of chronic liver injury, which can progress to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma, representing a major cause of mortality in patients with chronic liver disease. Kadsura coccinea (Lem.) A. C. Smith possesses pharmacological properties, including antitumor and anti-inflammatory effects, and is primarily used to treat rheumatism, hepatotoxicity injury, and chronic hepatitis. Acetylbinankadsurin A (ACBA) is a natural compound extracted from the roots of Kadsura coccinea. However, there have been few studies on the pharmacological activity of ACBA. This study aimed to investigate whether ACBA decreases macrophage glycolysis and pro-inflammatory phenotype polarization by inhibiting HIF-1alpha to alleviate hepatic fibrosis in mice. In this study, CCl(4)-induced mouse liver fibrosis models and lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced THP-1 monocytic cell lines were utilized to simulate macrophage polarization. Techniques such as Western blotting and immunofluorescence were applied to analyze macrophage glycolysis and phenotypes. Our findings revealed that ACBA alleviated CCl(4)-induced hepatic fibrosis in mice and suppressed LPS-induced M1 macrophage polarization. We observed that ACBA significantly reduced the expression of HIF-1alpha and macrophage glycolysis in liver fibrosis tissue and LPS-induced M1 macrophages. Furthermore, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and SPR assays demonstrated that there are three sites on the HIF-1alpha amino acid residues that can stably bind with ACBA in vitro. In conclusion, these results suggest that ACBA inhibits the activity of HIF-1alpha, thereby decreasing macrophage glycolysis and the pro-inflammatory phenotype, which alleviates hepatic fibrosis in mice.
abstract_zh: 肝纤维化是慢性肝损伤中常见的病理过程，可进展为肝硬化和肝细胞癌，是慢性肝病患者死亡的主要原因。Kadsura coccinea (Lem.) A. C. Smith 具有药理特性，包括抗肿瘤和抗炎作用，主要用于治疗风湿病、肝毒性损伤和慢性肝炎。乙酰基联南五味子素A (ACBA) 是从Kadsura coccinea根部提取的天然化合物。然而，关于ACBA药理活性的研究较少。本研究旨在探讨ACBA是否通过抑制HIF-1alpha降低巨噬细胞糖酵解和促炎表型极化，从而减轻小鼠肝纤维化。本研究采用CCl(4)诱导的小鼠肝纤维化模型和脂多糖 (LPS) 诱导的THP-1单核细胞系来模拟巨噬细胞极化。应用Western blotting和免疫荧光等技术分析巨噬细胞糖酵解和表型。我们的研究结果显示，ACBA减轻了CCl(4)诱导的小鼠肝纤维化，并抑制了LPS诱导的M1巨噬细胞极化。我们观察到，ACBA显著降低了肝纤维化组织和LPS诱导的M1巨噬细胞中HIF-1alpha的表达和巨噬细胞糖酵解。此外，分子对接、分子动力学模拟和SPR实验表明，HIF-1alpha氨基酸残基上有三个位点能在体外与ACBA稳定结合。总之，这些结果表明，ACBA抑制HIF-1alpha的活性，从而降低巨噬细胞糖酵解和促炎表型，进而减轻小鼠肝纤维化。
